paragraphs: I am a data scientist with 8+ years of experience in Python, SQL, machine learning, statistical analysis and predictive modeling, focused on financial services and customer behavior.
At PNC I build XGBoost models on 250K+ banking transactions for risk assessment. I prepare 500K+ financial records with PySpark and track 8+ model experiments in MLflow so the work is reproducible.

Before that, at Synchrony, I segmented consumer credit customers with K-Means, tested differences between customer groups, and forecasted transaction volume with ARIMA. I also built Tableau dashboards covering 10+ portfolio KPIs.
I am also working with generative AI and LLM tooling, including RAG, embeddings, semantic search, LangChain and LangGraph.
